summaries.R1-L1: Under-invoicing can be used to move value out of a country by paying less for goods than they are worth. The officer could ask the customer to explain the significantly lower price compared to typical market rates.
summaries.R4-INV: Inconsistent geographical information can indicate an attempt to obscure the true origin or movement of goods. The officer could ask the customer for documentation explaining why goods originating in Turkey are being shipped from the UAE.
